title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Reporting Window and Post-Return Recharge Amounts
content:
After the vehicle is handed back, what the supplier may still raise against the rental is governed by class amounts. The six Car Rental Rate Classes publish them as follows.

| Rate class | Damage reporting window (calendar days) | Damage administration (USD) | Toll administration, each toll (USD) | Traffic fine administration, each fine (USD) | Cleaning (USD) | Smoking (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | 14 | 125.00 | 9.95 | 49.00 | 150.00 | 400.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | 14 | 110.00 | 9.95 | 45.00 | 140.00 | 375.00 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | 10 | 95.00 | 8.95 | 39.00 | 125.00 | 350.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | 7 | 75.00 | 6.95 | 29.00 | 110.00 | 325.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | 5 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 | 95.00 | 300.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | 10 | 65.00 | 5.95 | 25.00 | 110.00 | 325.00 |

The reporting window is the number of calendar days after return within which the supplier may report new damage. The damage administration amount is the administration charge added to a damage settlement. The two administration columns beside it are the administration charge added to each toll and to each traffic fine recharged to the renter. The cleaning amount applies where the vehicle is returned needing more than ordinary cleaning, and the smoking amount where it is returned smelling of smoke.

**Boundary illustration on the window.** The reporting window is longest on the two Pay Now classes at 14 calendar days, stands at 10 on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate, at 7 on the Inclusive Flex Rate and at 5 on the Premium Inclusive Rate. Taking a hypothetical return on the Inclusive Flex Rate, a window of 7 calendar days stands open through the seventh day after the return date and no longer.

**The money columns.** Damage administration runs 125, 110, 95, 75, 0 and 65 down the table. Toll administration runs 9.95, 9.95, 8.95, 6.95, 0 and 5.95; fine administration runs 49, 45, 39, 29, 25 and 25. Cleaning runs 150, 140, 125, 110, 95 and 110, and the smoking amount 400, 375, 350, 325, 300 and 325.
